{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPQ43HrthDu5v8BqRuvW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnPost.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Post\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn post` command validates and stores one new transaction and prints its row. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes    | transactions.create, transactions.list, accounts.get, categories.get, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]` records one receipt or payment\nagainst an account. The command checks every input and the resulting balance before its first\nwrite, so a rejected post changes nothing.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger txn post` with four or five arguments.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2 (fewer than four or more than five arguments after `post`).\n2. Validate the account code, category code, amount, date, and memo with the shared validators. Any invalid value exits 3.\n3. Look up the account with `accounts.get` and the category with `categories.get`. An unknown account or category exits 3.\n4. Convert the amount to integer cents. Zero and amounts with more than two decimal places exit 3.\n5. List the account's transactions with `transactions.list` and run `check_balances` with the proposed added row. A balance below zero exits 3.\n6. List all transactions with `transactions.list`, take the largest `txn_id` plus one (or `1` when none exist) as the new id.\n7. Store the row with `transactions.create`, then print the header row and the stored row as CSV. Exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<amount with two decimals>,<memo>\n```\n\nAn omitted memo is stored and printed as an empty field. Failures write one diagnostic line to standard error and nothing to standard output.\n\n## Reads\n\n- `accounts.get`, `categories.get`, `transactions.list`\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.create`, only after every check has passed\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — write: create the new transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list transactions to find the largest id and the account balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-002` — read: confirm the category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-roundtrip ===\nIntent: A valid post prints the stored row, assigns the largest id plus one, and persists the amount as integer cents.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TPOST1\"\ncat = \"TPCAT1\"\namount_text = \"45.50\"\ncents = 4550\nwhen = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before_max = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, when, memo)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    data = rows[1]\n    assert int(data[0]) == before_max + 1\n    assert data[1] == when\n    assert data[2] == acct\n    assert data[3] == cat\n    assert data[4] == amount_text\n    assert data[5] == memo\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(data[0]))\n    assert stored is not None\n    assert stored.amount == cents\n    assert isinstance(stored.amount, int)\n    assert stored.account == acct\n    assert stored.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-post-roundtrip ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-memo-optional ===\nIntent: A post without a memo succeeds and stores an empty memo.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TPOST2\"\ncat = \"TPCAT2\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(rows[1][0]))\n    assert stored is not None\n    assert stored.memo == \"\"\n    assert len(rows[1]) == 6\n=== END AC txn-post-memo-optional ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-rejects-invalid ===\nIntent: An unknown account, unknown category, over-precise amount, zero amount, or impossible date exits 3 and stores nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TPOST3\"\ncat = \"TPCAT3\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    cases = [\n        (\"TPNOACCT\", cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, \"TPNOCAT\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.234\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"0\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"not-a-date\"),\n    ]\n    for args in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", *args)\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-post-rejects-invalid ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-negative-balance ===\nIntent: A payment larger than the account balance exits 3 and stores nothing, while a payment within the balance succeeds.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TPOST4\"\ncat = \"TPCAT4\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    start = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=start, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=1000, memo=\"seed\"\n    )\n    before = len(db.transactions.list(account=acct))\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-10.01\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == before\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-5.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = db.transactions.list(account=acct)\n    assert len(rows) == before + 1\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in rows) == 500\n=== END AC txn-post-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-usage ===\nIntent: Too few or too many arguments exit 2 and store nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"TPOST5\", \"TPCAT5\", \"1.00\")\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"m\", \"extra\")\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-post-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Every input and the resulting balance are checked before the first write; a rejected post stores nothing.\n- Amounts are integer cents at every layer; floating point is never used for money.\n- The next `txn_id` is computed from stored rows, never from a counter or constant.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only; standard output carries CSV on success and nothing on failure.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnGet.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Get\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn get` command prints one stored transaction row by id. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn get |\n| Consumes    | transactions.get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn get <id>` shows one stored transaction so an operator can confirm what was recorded.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger txn get <id>`.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Reject an id that is not an integer with exit 3.\n3. Read the row with `transactions.get`. An absent id exits 4.\n4. Print the header row and the row, with the amount written with exactly two decimals. Exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<amount with two decimals>,<memo>\n```\n\n## Reads\n\n- `transactions.get`\n\n## Writes\n\n- None.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: retrieve a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-get-present ===\nIntent: Getting a stored transaction prints its header and a row carrying the stored values with a two-decimal amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TGET1\"\ncat = \"TGCAT1\"\nwhen = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"get probe\"\ndeposit_cents = 1234\ndeposit_text = \"12.34\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Get Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Category\")\n    txn_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=when, account=acct, category=cat, amount=deposit_cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(txn_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(txn_id), when, acct, cat, deposit_text, memo]\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n=== END AC txn-get-present ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-negative-amount ===\nIntent: A negative stored amount prints with a leading minus sign and two decimals.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TGET2\"\ncat = \"TGCAT2\"\ncents = -1250\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Get Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Category\")\n    txn_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(txn_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    shown = rows[1][4]\n    assert shown.startswith(\"-\")\n    assert len(shown.split(\".\")[1]) == 2\n    assert Decimal(shown) * 100 == cents\n=== END AC txn-get-negative-amount ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-absent ===\nIntent: Getting an id that is not stored exits 4 with nothing on standard output.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    absent = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(absent))\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-get-absent ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-bad-arguments ===\nIntent: A non-integer id exits 3 and a wrong argument count exits 2.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"abc\")\nassert code == 3\nassert out == \"\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\")\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\", \"2\")\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-get-bad-arguments ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The command is read-only and never writes.\n- The amount is formatted from integer cents without floating point.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnAmend.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Amend\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn amend` command changes only the amount of one stored transaction, refusing any change that leaves a negative balance. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes    | transactions.get, transactions.update, transactions.list, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` corrects the amount of a recorded transaction. Date, account, category, and memo never change.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger txn amend <id> <amount>`.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Reject a non-integer id or an invalid amount (zero, more than two decimals, malformed) with exit 3.\n3. Read the row with `transactions.get`. An absent id exits 4.\n4. List the account's transactions and run `check_balances` with the proposed changed amount. A balance below zero exits 3 before any write.\n5. Store the new amount with `transactions.update` and print the header row and updated row. Exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<new amount with two decimals>,<memo>\n```\n\n## Reads\n\n- `transactions.get`, `transactions.list`\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.update` setting only `amount`, after every check has passed\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: retrieve the ===\n# FEATURE: Transfer\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger transfer` command moves cash between two distinct accounts by storing two matching TRANSFER rows, both or neither. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger transfer |\n| Consumes    | transactions.create, transactions.list, accounts.get, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` records an equal debit on the source account and credit on the destination account in category `TRANSFER`, so total cash held is unchanged.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger transfer` with four arguments.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Validate both account codes, the amount, and the date. The accounts must differ, the amount must be positive with at most two decimals, and the date must be a real calendar date. Any violation exits 3.\n3. Look up both accounts with `accounts.get`. An unknown account exits 3.\n4. List the source account's transactions and run `check_balances` with the proposed debit and credit. A balance below zero exits 3.\n5. Compute `n` as the largest stored `txn_id` plus one (or `1` when none exist).\n6. Store the outgoing row (`-amount`, source account, id `n`, memo `transfer to <to>`) and the incoming row (`+amount`, destination account, id `n+1`, memo `transfer from <from>`), both in category `TRANSFER`, both as one unit of work: both are stored or neither.\n7. Print the header row and both rows, outgoing first. Exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<n>,<date>,<from>,TRANSFER,-<amount>,transfer to <to>\n<n+1>,<date>,<to>,TRANSFER,<amount>,transfer from <from>\n```\n\n## Reads\n\n- `accounts.get`, `transactions.list`\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.create` twice, only after every check has passed\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — write: create the outgoing and incoming rows - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list transactions to find the largest id and the source balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: confirm each account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-valid ===\nIntent: A valid transfer prints two consecutive-id TRANSFER rows with opposite amounts and stores both.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"TRFSRC1\"\ndst = \"TRFDST1\"\namount_text = \"250.00\"\nwhen = \"2026-04-03\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Destination\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRFOPEN\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRFOPEN\", description=\"Transfer opening\")\n    first = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=first, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=100000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n    before_max = first\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount_text, when)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n    out_row, in_row = rows[1], rows[2]\n    assert int(out_row[0]) == before_max + 1\n    assert int(in_row[0]) == int(out_row[0]) + 1\n    assert out_row[1] == when and in_row[1] == when\n    assert out_row[2] == src and in_row[2] == dst\n    assert out_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\" and in_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert Decimal(out_row[4]) == -Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert Decimal(in_row[4]) == Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert out_row[5].endswith(dst)\n    assert in_row[5].endswith(src)\n    stored_out = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(out_row[0]))\n    stored_in = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(in_row[0]))\n    assert stored_out is not None and stored_in is not None\n    assert stored_out.amount == -25000\n    assert stored_in.amount == 25000\n    assert stored_out.category == \"TRANSFER\" and stored_in.category == \"TRANSFER\"\n=== END AC transfer-valid ===\n\n=== AC transfer-conserves-cash ===\nIntent: A valid transfer changes the two balances by opposite amounts and leaves their combined total unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"TRFSRC2\"\ndst = \"TRFDST2\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Destination\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRFOPEN\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRFOPEN\", description=\"Transfer opening\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=50000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=dst, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=1000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n\n    def balance(code):\n        return sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=code))\n\n    src_before, dst_before = balance(src), balance(dst)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"100.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert balance(src) == src_before - 10000\n    assert balance(dst) == dst_before + 10000\n    assert balance(src) + balance(dst) == src_before + dst_before\n=== END AC transfer-conserves-cash ===\n\n=== AC transfer-rejects-invalid ===\nIntent: Equal accounts, a zero or negative amount, an unknown account, or an impossible date exit 3 and store no rows.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"TRFSRC3\"\ndst = \"TRFDST3\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Destination\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRFOPEN\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRFOPEN\", description=\"Transfer opening\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=50000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    cases = [\n        (src, src, \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"0\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"0.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"-5.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, \"TRFNONE\", \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRFNONE\", dst, \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"1.234\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"10.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n    ]\n    for args in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", *args)\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC transfer-rejects-invalid ===\n\n=== AC transfer-insufficient-funds ===\nIntent: A transfer larger than the source balance exits 3 and stores neither row.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"TRFSRC4\"\ndst = \"TRFDST4\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Destination\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRFOPEN\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRFOPEN\", description=\"Transfer opening\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=10000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n    before_all = len(db.transactions.list())\n    before_src = len(db.transactions.list(account=src))\n    before_dst = len(db.transactions.list(account=dst))\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"100.01\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before_all\n    assert len(db.transactions.list(account=src)) == before_src\n    assert len(db.transactions.list(account=dst)) == before_dst\n=== END AC transfer-insufficient-funds ===\n\n=== AC transfer-usage ===\nIntent: A wrong argument count exits 2 and stores nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\")\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-03\", \"extra\")\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC transfer-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Both rows are stored or neither; every check completes before the first write.\n- The two accounts differ and the amount is positive; zero and negative amounts are BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnPost.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Post\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn post` command validates and stores one new transaction and prints its row. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes    | transactions.create, transactions.list, accounts.get, categories.get, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]` records one receipt or payment\nagainst an account. The command checks every input and the resulting balance before its first\nwrite, so a rejected post changes nothing.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger txn post` with four or five arguments.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2 (fewer than four or more than five arguments after `post`).\n2. Validate the account code, category code, amount, date, and memo with the shared validators. Any invalid value exits 3.\n3. Look up the account with `accounts.get` and the category with `categories.get`. An unknown account or category exits 3.\n4. Convert the amount to integer cents. Zero and amounts with more than two decimal places exit 3.\n5. List the account's transactions with `transactions.list` and run `check_balances` with the proposed added row. A balance below zero exits 3.\n6. List all transactions with `transactions.list`, take the largest `txn_id` plus one (or `1` when none exist) as the new id.\n7. Store the row with `transactions.create`, then print the header row and the stored row as CSV. Exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<amount with two decimals>,<memo>\n```\n\nAn omitted memo is stored and printed as an empty field. Failures write one diagnostic line to standard error and nothing to standard output.\n\n## Reads\n\n- `accounts.get`, `categories.get`, `transactions.list`\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.create`, only after every check has passed\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — write: create the new transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list transactions to find the largest id and the account balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-002` — read: confirm the category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-roundtrip ===\nIntent: A valid post prints the stored row, assigns the largest id plus one, and persists the amount as integer cents.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TPOST1\"\ncat = \"TPCAT1\"\namount_text = \"45.50\"\ncents = 4550\nwhen = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before_max = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0])\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, when, memo)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    data = rows[1]\n    assert int(data[0]) == before_max + 1\n    assert data[1] == when\n    assert data[2] == acct\n    assert data[3] == cat\n    assert data[4] == amount_text\n    assert data[5] == memo\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(data[0]))\n    assert stored is not None\n    assert stored.amount == cents\n    assert isinstance(stored.amount, int)\n    assert stored.account == acct\n    assert stored.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-post-roundtrip ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-memo-optional ===\nIntent: A post without a memo succeeds and stores an empty memo.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TPOST2\"\ncat = \"TPCAT2\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(rows[1][0]))\n    assert stored is not None\n    assert stored.memo == \"\"\n    assert len(rows[1]) == 6\n=== END AC txn-post-memo-optional ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-rejects-invalid ===\nIntent: An unknown account, unknown category, over-precise amount, zero amount, or impossible date exits 3 and stores nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TPOST3\"\ncat = \"TPCAT3\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    cases = [\n        (\"TPNOACCT\", cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, \"TPNOCAT\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.234\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"0\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"not-a-date\"),\n    ]\n    for args in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", *args)\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-post-rejects-invalid ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-negative-balance ===\nIntent: A payment larger than the account balance exits 3 and stores nothing, while a payment within the balance succeeds.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TPOST4\"\ncat = \"TPCAT4\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    start = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=start, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=1000, memo=\"seed\"\n    )\n    before = len(db.transactions.list(account=acct))\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-10.01\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == before\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-5.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = db.transactions.list(account=acct)\n    assert len(rows) == before + 1\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in rows) == 500\n=== END AC txn-post-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-usage ===\nIntent: Too few or too many arguments exit 2 and store nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"TPOST5\", \"TPCAT5\", \"1.00\")\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"m\", \"extra\")\n    assert code == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-post-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Every input and the resulting balance are checked before the first write; a rejected post stores nothing.\n- Amounts are integer cents at every layer; floating point is never used for money.\n- The next `txn_id` is computed from stored rows, never from a counter or constant.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only; standard output carries CSV on success and nothing on failure.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnGet.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Get\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn get` command prints one stored transaction row by id. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn get |\n| Consumes    | transactions.get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn get <id>` shows one stored transaction so an operator can confirm what was recorded.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger txn get <id>`.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Reject an id that is not an integer with exit 3.\n3. Read the row with `transactions.get`. An absent id exits 4.\n4. Print the header row and the row, with the amount written with exactly two decimals. Exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<amount with two decimals>,<memo>\n```\n\n## Reads\n\n- `transactions.get`\n\n## Writes\n\n- None.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: retrieve a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-get-present ===\nIntent: Getting a stored transaction prints its header and a row carrying the stored values with a two-decimal amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TGET1\"\ncat = \"TGCAT1\"\nwhen = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"get probe\"\ndeposit_cents = 1234\ndeposit_text = \"12.34\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Get Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Category\")\n    txn_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=when, account=acct, category=cat, amount=deposit_cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(txn_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(txn_id), when, acct, cat, deposit_text, memo]\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n=== END AC txn-get-present ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-negative-amount ===\nIntent: A negative stored amount prints with a leading minus sign and two decimals.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TGET2\"\ncat = \"TGCAT2\"\ncents = -1250\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Get Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Category\")\n    txn_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(txn_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    shown = rows[1][4]\n    assert shown.startswith(\"-\")\n    assert len(shown.split(\".\")[1]) == 2\n    assert Decimal(shown) * 100 == cents\n=== END AC txn-get-negative-amount ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-absent ===\nIntent: Getting an id that is not stored exits 4 with nothing on standard output.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    absent = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(absent))\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-get-absent ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-bad-arguments ===\nIntent: A non-integer id exits 3 and a wrong argument count exits 2.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"abc\")\nassert code == 3\nassert out == \"\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\")\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\", \"2\")\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-get-bad-arguments ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The command is read-only and never writes.\n- The amount is formatted from integer cents without floating point.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnAmend.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Amend\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn amend` command changes only the amount of one stored transaction, refusing any change that leaves a negative balance. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes    | transactions.get, transactions.update, transactions.list, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` corrects the amount of a recorded transaction. Date, account, category, and memo never change.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger txn amend <id> <amount>`.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Reject a non-integer id or an invalid amount (zero, more than two decimals, malformed) with exit 3.\n3. Read the row with `transactions.get`. An absent id exits 4.\n4. List the account's transactions and run `check_balances` with the proposed changed amount. A balance below zero exits 3 before any write.\n5. Store the new amount with `transactions.update` and print the header row and updated row. Exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<id>,<date>,<account>,<category>,<new amount with two decimals>,<memo>\n```\n\n## Reads\n\n- `transactions.get`, `transactions.list`\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.update` setting only `amount`, after every check has passed\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: retrieve the transaction to amend - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list the account's transactions for the balance check - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-004` — write: change the amount - supplies: `txn_id`, `amount` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-amend-roundtrip ===\nIntent: Amending a deposit prints the updated row and persists only the new amount in integer cents.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TAMD1\"\ncat = \"TACAT1\"\nwhen = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"amend probe\"\nnew_text = \"60.00\"\nnew_cents = 6000\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    txn_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=when, account=acct, category=cat, amount=5000, memo=memo\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(txn_id), new_text)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(txn_id), when, acct, cat, new_text, memo]\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    assert stored.amount == new_cents\n    assert stored.date == when\n    assert stored.account == acct\n    assert stored.category == cat\n    assert stored.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-amend-roundtrip ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-absent ===\nIntent: Amending an id that is not stored exits 4 and stores nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    absent = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1000\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(absent), \"1.00\")\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-amend-absent ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-negative-balance ===\nIntent: An amendment that would leave the account balance below zero exits 3 and leaves the amount unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TAMD2\"\ncat = \"TACAT2\"\noriginal = 1000\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    deposit = base\n    payment = base + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=deposit, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=original, memo=\"in\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=payment, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-500, memo=\"out\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(deposit), \"0.10\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=deposit).amount == original\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=payment).amount == -500\n=== END AC txn-amend-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-invalid-amount ===\nIntent: A zero or over-precise amount exits 3 and leaves the stored amount unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TAMD3\"\ncat = \"TACAT3\"\noriginal = 2500\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    txn_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=original, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    for bad in [\"0\", \"1.234\", \"abc\"]:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(txn_id), bad)\n        print(bad, code, err)\n        assert count exits 2.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\")\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"2.00\", \"extra\")\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-amend-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Only the amount changes; date, account, category, and memo are never written.\n- The balance check completes before the first write; a rejected amendment changes nothing.\n- Amounts are integer cents; floating point is never used for money.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnDelete.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Delete\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger txn delete` command removes one stored transaction unless doing so would leave a negative balance. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn delete |\n| Consumes    | transactions.get, transactions.delete, transactions.list, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn delete <id>` removes a recorded transaction. Removing a deposit can drive a balance below zero, so the balance rule is checked first.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger txn delete <id>`.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Reject a non-integer id with exit 3.\n3. Read the row with `transactions.get`. An absent id exits 4.\n4. List the account's transactions and run `check_balances` with the row removed. A balance below zero exits 3 and the row is kept.\n5. Remove the row with `transactions.delete`, print `deleted` and the id on separate lines, and exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ndeleted\n<id>\n```\n\n## Reads\n\n- `transactions.get`, `transactions.list`\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.delete`, after every check has passed\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: retrieve the transaction to delete - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list the account's transactions for the balance check - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-005` — write: remove the transaction - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-delete-roundtrip ===\nIntent: Deleting a stored transaction prints deleted and the id, and a later read finds nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TDEL1\"\ncat = \"TDCAT1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Delete Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Category\")\n    txn_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=4550, memo=\"gone\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(txn_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"deleted\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(txn_id)]\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is None\n=== END AC txn-delete-roundtrip ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-absent ===\nIntent: Deleting an id that is not stored exits 4 and removes nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    absent = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1000\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(absent))\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-delete-absent ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-negative-balance ===\nIntent: Deleting a deposit that later payments depend on exits 3 and keeps the row.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"TDEL2\"\ncat = \"TDCAT2\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Delete Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Category\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    deposit = base\n    payment = base + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=deposit, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=1000, memo=\"in\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=payment, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-500, memo=\"out\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(deposit))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=deposit) is not None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=payment) is not None\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(payment))\n    assert code == 0\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=payment) is None\n=== END AC txn-delete-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txn-delete-bad-arguments ===\nIntent: A non-integer id exits 3 and a wrong argument count exits 2.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"abc\")\nassert code == 3\nassert out == \"\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\")\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\", \"2\")\nassert code == 2\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-delete-bad-arguments ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The balance check completes before the delete; a rejected delete keeps every row.\n- Only the named transaction is removed; no other row is touched.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Transfer.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transfer\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | The `ledger transfer` command moves cash between two distinct accounts by storing two matching TRANSFER rows, both or neither. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger transfer |\n| Consumes    | transactions.create, transactions.list, accounts.get, check_balances |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` records an equal debit on the source account and credit on the destination account in category `TRANSFER`, so total cash held is unchanged.\n\n## Trigger\n\nAn operator runs `./ledger transfer` with four arguments.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Reject a wrong argument count with exit 2.\n2. Validate both account codes, the amount, and the date. The accounts must differ, the amount must be positive with at most two decimals, and the date must be a real calendar date. Any violation exits 3.\n3. Look up both accounts with `accounts.get`. An unknown account exits 3.\n4. List the source account's transactions and run `check_balances` with the proposed debit and credit. A balance below zero exits 3.\n5. Compute `n` as the largest stored `txn_id` plus one (or `1` when none exist).\n6. Store the outgoing row (`-amount`, source account, id `n`, memo `transfer to <to>`) and the incoming row (`+amount`, destination account, id `n+1`, memo `transfer from <from>`), both in category `TRANSFER`, both as one unit of work: both are stored or neither.\n7. Print the header row and both rows, outgoing first. Exit 0.\n\n## Output\n\n```text\ntxn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo\n<n>,<date>,<from>,TRANSFER,-<amount>,transfer to <to>\n<n+1>,<date>,<to>,TRANSFER,<amount>,transfer from <from>\n```\n\n## Reads\n\n- `accounts.get`, `transactions.list`\n\n## Writes\n\n- `transactions.create` twice, only after every check has passed\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-001` — write: create the outgoing and incoming rows - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — read: list transactions to find the largest id and the source balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-002` — read: confirm each account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-valid ===\nIntent: A valid transfer prints two consecutive-id TRANSFER rows with opposite amounts and stores both.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"TRFSRC1\"\ndst = \"TRFDST1\"\namount_text = \"250.00\"\nwhen = \"2026-04-03\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Destination\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRFOPEN\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRFOPEN\", description=\"Transfer opening\")\n    first = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=first, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=100000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n    before_max = first\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount_text, when)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n    out_row, in_row = rows[1], rows[2]\n    assert int(out_row[0]) == before_max + 1\n    assert int(in_row[0]) == int(out_row[0]) + 1\n    assert out_row[1] == when and in_row[1] == when\n    assert out_row[2] == src and in_row[2] == dst\n    assert out_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\" and in_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert Decimal(out_row[4]) == -Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert Decimal(in_row[4]) == Decimal(amount_text)\n    assert out_row[5].endswith(dst)\n    assert in_row[5].endswith(src)\n    stored_out = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(out_row[0]))\n    stored_in = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(in_row[0]))\n    assert stored_out is not None and stored_in is not None\n    assert stored_out.amount == -25000\n    assert stored_in.amount == 25000\n    assert stored_out.category == \"TRANSFER\" and stored_in.category == \"TRANSFER\"\n=== END AC transfer-valid ===\n\n=== AC transfer-conserves-cash ===\nIntent: A valid transfer changes the two balances by opposite amounts and leaves their combined total unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"TRFSRC2\"\ndst = \"TRFDST2\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Destination\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRFOPEN\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRFOPEN\", description=\"Transfer opening\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=50000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base + 1, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=dst, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=1000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n\n    def balance(code):\n        return sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=code))\n\n    src_before, dst_before = balance(src), balance(dst)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"100.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert balance(src) == src_before - 10000\n    assert balance(dst) == dst_before + 10000\n    assert balance(src) + balance(dst) == src_before + dst_before\n=== END AC transfer-conserves-cash ===\n\n=== AC transfer-rejects-invalid ===\nIntent: Equal accounts, a zero or negative amount, an unknown account, or an impossible date exit 3 and store name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Destination\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRFOPEN\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRFOPEN\", description=\"Transfer opening\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=50000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    cases = [\n        (src, src, \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"0\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"0.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"-5.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, \"TRFNONE\", \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (\"TRFNONE\", dst, \"10.00\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"1.234\", \"2026-04-03\"),\n        (src, dst, \"10.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n    ]\n    for args in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", *args)\n        print(args, code, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC transfer-rejects-invalid ===\n\n=== AC transfer-insufficient-funds ===\nIntent: A transfer larger than the source balance exits 3 and stores neither row.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsrc = \"TRFSRC4\"\ndst = \"TRFDST4\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Transfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Transfer Destination\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRFOPEN\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRFOPEN\", description=\"Transfer opening\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()] or [0]) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=base, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=src, category=\"TRFOPEN\", amount=10000, memo=\"fund\"\n    )\n    before_all = len(db.transactions.list())\n    before_src = len(db.transactions.list(account=src))\n    before_dst = len(db.transactions.list(account=dst))\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"100.01\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before_all\n    assert len(db.transactions.list(account=src)) == before_src\n    assert len(db.transactions.list(account=dst)) == before_dst\n=== END AC transfer-insufficient-funds ===\n\n=== AC transfer-usage ===\nIntent:
